description: Supplier register for 0xCMS (W10; A.5.19, A.5.20, A.5.21, A.5.23). One entry per supplier relationship, each tied to a supplier entry in asset-inventory.json. Services and data shared come from source. Agreement, risk assessment and review fields record evidence the organisation holds; they stay not-evidenced until someone records where that evidence is. Contract text and account details belong in the restricted evidence system, not here.

agreement.not-required: Assessed as not needing a specific agreement; reason recorded

assessment.done: Risk assessment recorded with a date
assessment.not-required: Assessed as out of scope; reason recorded

suppliers.name: Cloudflare
suppliers.phi: If a deployment holds PHI, a BAA covering every service in this list is a release prerequisite. Confirm with Cloudflare which services the BAA covers; do not assume all of them are.
suppliers.exit: D1: wrangler d1 export, checked with tools/check-export.mjs. R2: copy objects through the S3-compatible API, including the audit archive. Durable Objects: PageSync holds only unsaved edits and FormOnce single-use tokens, both disposable. Queues: drain before cut-over; durable state is in DB.admin_jobs. Secrets: re-created by their owners, never exported.

suppliers.name: GitHub (sign-in)
suppliers.phi: Receives no PHI. Learns that a user signs in to this CMS.
suppliers.exit: Remove from ENABLED_PROVIDERS. Users keep access only through another linked provider.

suppliers.name: Eventuai identity provider (in-house oauth Worker)
suppliers.phi: Receives no PHI. Holds its own users' password hashes.

agreement.reference: Operated by the same organisation; govern it as an internal system, not a supplier

suppliers.exit: Remove from ENABLED_PROVIDERS once users have another linked provider.

suppliers.name: GitHub (source and CI)
suppliers.phi: Receives no PHI as long as tests use synthetic data and no export is committed.
suppliers.exit: Clone with full history; CI is a single workflow file.

suppliers.name: npm registry

agreement.reference: Public registry; managed as a supply-chain risk (A.5.21) through package-lock.json, Dependabot and npm audit

suppliers.exit: package-lock.json pins every version; a mirror or vendored copy can replace the registry.

suppliers.name: Registered plugin Workers
suppliers.phi: A plugin receives what its approvals allow, plus the signed-in user's name, email and role on proxied requests. Each plugin operator handling PHI needs its own agreement.

agreement.reference: Per plugin; list each deployment's plugins from DB.plugins

suppliers.exit: Disable the plugin. Its host-side records stay in DB.plugin_state.
